newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes up on steel, refineries.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes up on steel, refineries.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed stronger on Wednesday as foreign investors chased steel mill Sidex and oil refineries, traders said.
Operators predicted buying pressure on refineries, some cement makers and Sidex would remain strong.
"Refineries, as well as Sidex are known to have sound economic results, so the rush for their shares should be no surprise," one operator said.
Advances outnumbered declines 132 to 110, with 478 unchanged.
The unofficial index VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, grew by 2.5 percent to 3,785.7 points, while the BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, rose by 3.22 percent to 2,793.83.
Another independent index, CAS-RQ, launched this week by Creditanstalt Securities, was up 3.21 percent to 637 points. All three indices are based on average prices and market capitalisation.
Sidex -- which has 15 percent of market capitalisation -- gained 1,400 lei at close to 14,600 under the market rally.
Refineries Arpechim and Petromidia were among gainers, ending 1,200 and 500 lei firmer at 26,700 and 22,000 respectively.
Cement maker Moldocim was under buying pressure and closed 4,000 lei stronger, while Romcim, another cement maker, displayed stability, closing flat at 75,000 lei.
Turnover rose to 10.8 billion lei from 9.2 billion on Tuesday.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CASE02.
